title: BatterVanish
description: BetterVanish is a Paper plugin for staff vanish
body:
## Features

- `/vanish`, `/v`, and `/vanish <player>`
- `/vanishlist`
- `/credits`
- Persistent vanish state
- Action bar and boss bar indicators
- Fake join and leave messages for non-staff viewers
- Mob targeting prevention
- Collision disable
- Auto flight while vanished
- Optional item pickup blocking
- Silent read-only container inspection
- PlaceholderAPI placeholder: `%vanish_status%`
- Bukkit service API: `StaffVanishApi`
- Configurable credits join message for `bettervanish.credits.join`

## Permissions

- `staff.vanish`
- `staff.vanish.others`
- `staff.vanish.see`

## Setup
2. Copy the jar into your server `plugins/` folder.
3. Start the server once and edit `plugins/BetterVanish/config.yml` as needed.
